scope: Pre-merge fast lane for PR 5, run once after the adversarial review fixes; only failed checks were rerun after their fixes

library.failure_cause: Test expectation defect present since the formats check was written (reproduced with the pre-review test source): an oversized Display Parameters block was expected to drop the whole DisplayID extension, but the parser records a failure, consumes the remaining bytes and keeps the section without a block. Corrected in appended patches 0010/0021; the library itself is unchanged.

focused_retry.note: Only check_formats changed; the three passing groups were not invalidated.

legacy_consumers.method: Binaries compiled from the previous candidates (upstream 99a8bb3-equivalent, Ubuntu hdr7) executed against the new libraries via LD_LIBRARY_PATH; their RUNPATH ($ORIGIN/..) yields to LD_LIBRARY_PATH and the new library was confirmed loaded

mutter.environment: Ubuntu 26.10 amd64; UID 1000; mutter D-Bus test runner; LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE llvmpipe

results.mutter:wayland-color-management: OK (/wayland/color-management; four target cases skipped by -s)

probe.command: WAYLAND_COLOR_INFO_BUILD=$BUILD python3 -m unittest discover -s probes/wayland_color_info -p test_protocol.py -v (UID 1000)

wine.runtime: WineHQ wine-stable 11.0.0.0~noble-1 (amd64) in a disposable Ubuntu 24.04 container with the candidate win32u (.so/.dll), winex11 and winewayland (.so/.drv), user32, setupapi, cfgmgr32, windows.devices.enumeration and windows.devices.display modules overlaid; prefix created after the overlay; Xvfb display; WINEDLLOVERRIDES=mscoree,mshtml= to suppress installer dialogs
wine.first_run_failure: Instance-ID resolution returned ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE for every monitor: the enabled-interface check enumerated interfaces of a device-only information set, which never contains interfaces. Fixed by looking up enabled interfaces in the monitor interface class and matching the owning instance; the synthetic test ID now uses the upper-case form SetupAPI stores. A second attempt still exercised the old module because the existing prefix kept its installed copy; the prefix was refreshed with wineboot -u and the displaymonitor test was rerun alone.

repository: check_repository.py and the Python unittest discovery run once on the final tree (see PR)
limits: Synthetic and headless fixtures; no live display, installation, OEM component or physical measurement
Wine run is win64 with WineHQ binaries plus candidate modules, not a full candidate build
